title: Size of the Tuts Washington band
summary: The band was four or five pieces; they worked together on later jobs before his service.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You said you played your first job, first job with Toots.
Big job. Who was in that band? Oh, I don't know. Was it big band, four pieces? No, it was about, oh, about four or five pieces.
I was wondering how many, about Tits, because I always see him working as soloist so many
years. And I never really saw him with a group over those years.
Yeah. And we worked a lot of other jobs together after that.
Years later or that same 1930s or 40s with Toots?
